**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent)**

The agreement has no insurance provision anywhere — no insurance heading in the outline and zero text hits for "insur". The nearest neighbours only allocate risk of loss (§14.12) and describe security features with heavy disclaimers (§5.3). Since IBM hosts our environment and holds Customer Components, having no insurance obligation is walk-away territory under the rule.

Redline (validated, ok:true): a new §14.12A "Insurance" inserted after §14.12 at the preferred position — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where IBM processes our data, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request — with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback offered in the comment.
